definitions.definition: I={i∈ℤ:0≤i≤λ}. Factorials and binomial coefficients with indices in this range are those of the corresponding nonnegative integers.

definitions.type: family of complex linear endomorphisms of V indexed by nonnegative integers
definitions.definition: For each integer r≥0, X_r=x^r/r!, where powers denote composition of the action of x and X_0=Id_V.

definitions.type: family of complex linear endomorphisms of V indexed by nonnegative integers
definitions.definition: For each integer r≥0, Y_r=y^r/r!, where powers denote composition of the action of y and Y_0=Id_V.

definitions.type: integer subalgebra of the universal enveloping algebra of sl₂(C), with its action on V
definitions.definition: U_Z is the ℤ-subalgebra of the universal enveloping algebra generated by all divided powers x^r/r!,y^r/r! for integers r≥0; their actions on V are X_r,Y_r.

definitions.type: subring of ℚ, also embedded in ℂ
definitions.definition: R=ℤ_(p)={a/b∈ℚ:a,b∈ℤ, b≠0, p does not divide b}, with the usual rational arithmetic and its embedding into ℂ.
M_R=R⊗_ℤ M. Once its multiplication map into V is proved injective, it is identified with its image in V.
ι_R is the tensor multiplication map determined by ι_R(r⊗m)=r m for r∈R and m∈M, using the rational scalar action on V.

definitions.type: family of complex linear endomorphisms of V indexed by I×I
definitions.definition: For i,j∈I, E_ij is the unique complex linear map sending e_j to e_i and every e_k with k∈I and k≠j to zero. This definition is made only after (e_k)_{k∈I} has been proved to be a complex basis of V.

definitions.type: family of R-submodules of ℂ indexed by I
K-vector space with induced lattice operators
definitions.definition: V(K)=M⊗_ℤ K. Every ℤ-linear operator on M acts by its tensor extension on V(K). The same symbols x,y,h,X_r,Y_r denote the tensor-induced actions of their restrictions to M once their preservation of M has been proved; this notation asserts no such preservation by itself.

L(K)=(ℤx+ℤy+ℤh)⊗_ℤ K, the scalar extension of the Chevalley ℤ-form with the commutator bracket inherited from sl₂(C). This is the Chevalley sl₂ construction also when the characteristic is 2. Its action on V(K) is induced from the actions on M.

full_target: For every prime p, every field K of characteristic p, every integer λ with 0≤λ<p, the complex irreducible highest-weight sl₂(C)-module V=V(λ) of dimension λ+1 with Chevalley generators x,y,h, every nonzero v∈V with xv=0 and hv=λv, and every arbitrary admissible lattice M⊂V (a free abelian subgroup with an integer basis that is also a complex basis, stable under the integer enveloping subalgebra generated by all x^r/r!,y^r/r!), prove that V(K)=M⊗ℤK is nonzero and every K-linear subspace invariant under x,y,h is zero or V(K). Here L(K)=(ℤx+ℤy+ℤh)⊗ℤK acts by the induced lattice operators, including the Chevalley construction in characteristic 2. No algebraic closure assumption on K is made, and λ=0 and p=2 are included.

hypotheses.statement: The characteristic of the field K is p.
V=V(λ) is the complex irreducible highest-weight sl₂(C)-module of highest weight λ, of complex dimension λ+1. The elements x,y,h are its Chevalley generators and satisfy [h,x]=2x, [h,y]=-2y, [x,y]=h.

M is an admissible lattice: it is a free abelian subgroup of V with an integer basis that is also a complex basis of V, and is stable under U_Z. It is arbitrary and is not required to be the minimal lattice.
